folder_contract.defaults: group4/min0/max100 native/period-1/priority-1/type0/radius0/volume1; 68-byte folder includes path20 and vector48.
folder_contract.inheritance: Copy first20hex bytes from parent, covering all eight scalar slots, then parse immediate folder.set in order. No signal reset for a child lacking a declaration. Third parser argument is parent!=null, proven at4CF6F6/4CF713 assembly despite omitted decompiler argument.
folder_contract.root: Without parent, parser resets min/max from default loudness before local directives; it does not reset priority there.
folder_contract.loader: Only immediate .wav members become asset rows. Subdirectory samples are not recursively pooled. Cache keyed by normalized requested directory; parent resolved first. Mounted iterator ordering/overrides not closed.
folder_contract.distance: Distance and min/max are MULSS->MOVSS, not integer conversion despite misleading Ghidra C. Editor Distance branch adds min>0,max>min assertion.
folder_contract.loudness: 4D0B40 loads sound.set; duplicate case-insensitive name updates existing row, optional priority retained if absent. Lookup4D3D70 first matching native row or default108. Base audit has all244 declarations specifying priority; six duplicate names collapse to238 names.

selection_contract.path: Empty request returnsnull. Is-directory uses /sound/+path; directory selects empty stem, file selects parent and basename without extension. Empty folder or missing exact stem returnsnull.
selection_contract.explicit: First exact stem string match, no RNG and no cycle-counter change.
selection_contract.random: Single asset returns it without RNG. Multi-asset empty selector resets remaining to N only when zero, obtains default thread RNG5549F0, bypassing the selected TLS pointer read by554B50, increments counterC, updates state8=state*7FF8A3ED+2AA01D31 modulo2^32, decrements remaining, swaps entire48-byte rows at remaining and (state>>8)%old_remaining, returns remaining row.
selection_contract.implications: Sampling without replacement per complete random cycle; adjacent cycles may repeat. Multi-asset folder consumes one default-thread draw even when remaining==1. Exact-file selections can repeat and do not participate in cycle. No uniformity or mounted iteration-order guarantee.
selection_contract.row_mutation: Channels retain pointers to asset slots while selection swaps row contents. All slots in a folder share the same definition, so this swap does not change that folder signal descriptor; per-asset audible bookkeeping effects remain open.

publication_contract.separation: No local test of group volume, asset multiplier, folder volume or listener distance in signal gate. Radius does not multiply audible gain. snd_disable suppresses buffer loading/playback, but local publication is outside that branch. Event registration occurs before audio startup, including when startup fails. This is not proof of complete recipient hearing/mission behavior.
publication_contract.repeat: After initial publication, loop bit1 and positive folderC register18-byte raw-source row. On FD2, due unsigned deadlines are rescheduled now+convert(period); current channel position and folder descriptor are read, payload0. No raw-source retain/invalidation in these rows.
publication_contract.assertion: Editor3737F0 asserts ch when a repeat handle fails lookup; game has no equivalent local assertion before dereference. Validity still relies on lifecycle invariants.
publication_contract.handle: Low16 indexes60-byte channels then full32-bit equality; no bounds test in reviewed getter. Generation increments16 bits. Not a stable entity ID or ownership handle.

lifecycle_contract.explicit_stop: 4CDAD0 resolves handle, calls4D2FA0 to erase first matching repeat, then4CFFD0 ends playback/clears low3 flags/zeros gain. Stop does not invalidate or recycle handle.
lifecycle_contract.retire: 4D2E00 allocated-bit gate: erase first repeat for full handle, append low16 index to free queue, clear allocated bit, call4D0070 which stops, invalidates50, releases audio resource18 and clears low3 buffer flags.
lifecycle_contract.all_channels: 4D26B0 retires each channel before destroying buffers and clearing channel vector/free queue. Repeat cancellation follows per-channel valid allocation invariant; not an unconditional repeat-vector clear.
lifecycle_contract.pause: 4D1C90 sets managerC4, stops playing channels and marks58bit3; resume restarts marked loops and clears marker. No repeat erasure or deadline adjustment here. Whether FD2/clock advances while globally paused is outside this pass.
lifecycle_contract.arbitration_slice: 4D1E70 retires inactive/completed channels when58&0xC==0 and58&3!=3; non-tick calls preserve signal-bearing channels. Spatial audio minDistance nearzero also triggers retirement on active tick. Other quota paths can stop/defer buffers without removing repeat rows. Full priority sort/attenuation not reviewed.
lifecycle_contract.ownership_limit: Audio resource18 has reference-count release, raw repeat source8 does not. Earlier interaction-lifecycle pass establishes destroy-event cancellation for linked aliases. Other looping owners, position updates and entity lifetime remain open.

manager_events.scope: Registered by4D0B40; dispatched via Sound::eManager vslot1. Event names, producers and global clock/pause ordering remain open.
